name: PromiseOS
summary: PromiseOS is an AI-powered personal operating system that integrates calendar, email, and task management with real-time generative AI agents for intelligent daily briefings, voice-driven dictation, and automated scheduling.
recruiterExplanation: Cimil demonstrated exceptional full-stack engineering proficiency by building PromiseOS, an AI-first application. His work shows deep integration capabilities with LLMs (Gemini/Claude), complex OAuth orchestration, and billing logic (Stripe), highlighting his ability to deliver end-to-end production-grade software that solves real-world productivity problems.
technicalExplanation: The application leverages a Next.js App Router architecture with a serverless backend. It utilizes Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash for intelligent task/email processing and Anthropic's Claude/Whisper for conversational flows and transcription. The backend features robust API routes acting as intermediaries for Google Calendar and Gmail integration, using Supabase for persistent storage and authentication. It employs a mock-fallback strategy for development, ensuring high availability during API outages or configuration gaps.
architectureExplanation: It is a modular, client-server application built on the Next.js framework. It employs a controller-based pattern within the App Router for API route management, separating external integrations (MCP servers for calendar/email sync) from the core UI logic. It is highly event-driven, using webhooks for asynchronous billing state reconciliation with Stripe.

faqs.q: What was the main challenge in this project?
faqs.a: Managing state consistency between the local UI (React state) and the external Google workspace environment while handling secure asynchronous webhook events from Stripe for user subscription management.

faqs.q: How is the ML pipeline structured?
faqs.a: The pipeline utilizes a hybrid approach: local browser-based transcription for low latency, and backend API-driven extraction where specialized LLM prompts are dispatched to Gemini/Claude to parse unstructured text into structured JSON commitments saved to the database.
